entries.intent: Introduce a practical, dependency-free provenance record and validator for this repository, replacing the earlier heavier repository-provenance plan draft with a minimal MVP.
entries.human_direction: A maintainer requested scoping repository provenance down to a minimal, public-safe MVP: a small JSON record, disclosure classes, a validator, and matching PR template fields.

outcome.reference: seventwos-app/how-we-work pull request adding .seventwos/provenance.json v0.1, the provenance convention, its validator, and CI/PR-template integration

entries.intent: Refine the How We Work closing statement so collaboration at scale leads directly into building the future of Seventwos.
entries.human_direction: A maintainer supplied the exact replacement wording for the closing sentence and asked for it to be published.

outcome.reference: seventwos-app/how-we-work pull request refining the closing statement in README.md

entries.intent: Align the technology-stack specification with the actual upstream foundations, runtime boundaries, transition state, and licensing posture of the desktop, iOS, and Android client forks.
entries.human_direction: A maintainer requested revised wording that uses the term applications, asked for fact-checking, and directed that the stack reflect the organization's existing forks.

outcome.reference: seventwos-app/how-we-work pull request aligning the technology-stack specification with the three client forks

entries.intent: Render the technology-stack topology as an interactive Archify diagram, confirm the Matrix backend's deployment status in the specification, and publish the diagram via GitHub Pages so it is directly viewable.
entries.human_direction: A maintainer directed use of the MIT-licensed tt-a1i/archify tool to redraw the diagram, confirmed the Matrix backend is deployed, and asked for the rendered HTML to be hosted on GitHub Pages so it is clickable from the repository.

outcome.reference: seventwos-app/how-we-work pull request adding diagrams/stack.architecture.json, diagrams/stack.architecture.html, and enabling GitHub Pages

entries.intent: Remove the static Mermaid diagram from the technology-stack specification now that the interactive, published Archify diagram is the single source of the system topology.
entries.human_direction: A maintainer reported the diagram appearing below the interactive-diagram link as unnecessary.

outcome.reference: seventwos-app/how-we-work pull request removing the redundant Mermaid diagram from stack.md

entries.intent: Add a work-in-progress caveat to the interactive diagram references, clarifying some connection details are still being finalized.
entries.human_direction: A maintainer proposed caveat wording; the wording was tightened to avoid implying the diagram is speculative rather than provisional, and applied on approval.

outcome.reference: seventwos-app/how-we-work pull request adding a work-in-progress caveat to the diagram references

entries.intent: Correct the Agent Gateway description in the technology-stack specification and diagram, which previously stated an inaccurate implementation (Azure Functions, Cosmos DB).
entries.human_direction: A maintainer confirmed the Agent Gateway is VM-hosted and reaches frontier models via Azure AI Foundry, without a Cosmos DB dependency, while asking that the underlying product name remain undisclosed.

outcome.reference: seventwos-app/how-we-work pull request correcting the Agent Gateway description
